title: Livery manifest entry
description: One entry per visual asset. The manifest is the ONLY place that knows how to turn an ADS-B record into a file path — matcher.js reads it, nothing else hardcodes airline/type logic.

file.description: Path relative to liveries/, e.g. 'Emirates_A380_.webp'. Must exist on disk — build validates this.

match.description: What this asset depicts. At least one of typeCode/airlineIcao required.

typeCode.description: ICAO type designator, e.g. 'A388' (A380-800), 'B77W' (777-300ER). Source of truth: db/aircraft.sqlite airframe.type_code, or https://www.icao.int/publications/DOC8643

airlineIcao.description: 3-letter ICAO carrier code — same string as the first 3 chars of that airline's callsigns. Source of truth: db/airlines.json keys.

accent.description: Hex color used for UI chrome (route arc, callsign text) when this asset is shown. Pick something that reads on your background, not necessarily the exact brand color — see prior note about navy-on-dark needing to lighten.

tags.description: Optional free-form, e.g. ["wide-scale", "registration:G-XLEA"]. Not used by matching, just notes for humans.
